Closes #308

## Summary

Adds Organization offboarding: an Organization admin can export the Organization's non-Results data and, after typing the Organization name, delete the Organization. Deletion wipes the Organization's Durable Object and its D1 index.

## Changes

- Export holds only the Organization settings, Teams, People, Memberships, Pulses and Questions. It excludes Results, comments, Actions, Notes, Submissions, Answers and every token. The Results exclusion means ADR 0003 stands. ADR 0028 records this.
- Deletion needs the typed Organization name and the new `organization.offboard` permission (Organization admin only).
- Deletion wipes the Durable Object (`deleteAlarm`, then `deleteAll`) and the D1 index in this order: token indexes first, so Invitation tokens and Edit keys fail closed; then `email_message` and `captured_email` by message id, `person_index`, `organization_claim` and `organization_index`; then sign-in accounts left without a Person.
- New D1 migration `0012_organization_offboarding.sql` adds `organization_offboarding`, which lets the same admin finish a deletion after a crash. Its SHA-256 is in `d1-migrations.lock.json`.
- Web UI for export and deletion, with messages in the catalog.

## Scope notes

- Backups are not wiped by deletion. They expire after `Policy.backupRetentionDays` (30) days.
- Export and deletion are both Organization-admin only.

## Verification

- Privacy suite: `OrganizationOffboarding.privacy.test.ts`.
- Unit tests: `DirectoryApi` tests, domain tests (`Offboarding.test.ts`, `Permissions.test.ts`) and web tests (`App.scene.test.ts`, `App.story.test.ts`).
- Ran `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm check:ledger`, `pnpm check:comments`, `pnpm test` (1569 pass), `pnpm test:privacy` (279 pass), and the web build. All passed.
- The pre-commit hook ran `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` and passed.
EOF

## Summary

Adds Organization offboarding: an Organization admin can export the Organization's non-Results data and, after typing the Organization name, delete the Organization. Deletion wipes the Organization's Durable Object and its D1 index.

## Changes

- Export holds only the Organization settings, Teams, People, Memberships, Pulses and Questions. It excludes Results, comments, Actions, Notes, Submissions, Answers and every token. The Results exclusion means ADR 0003 stands. ADR 0028 records this.
- Deletion needs the typed Organization name and the new `organization.offboard` permission (Organization admin only).
- Deletion wipes the Durable Object (`deleteAlarm`, then `deleteAll`) and the D1 index in this order: token indexes first, so Invitation tokens and Edit keys fail closed; then `email_message` and `captured_email` by message id, `person_index`, `organization_claim` and `organization_index`; then sign-in accounts left without a Person.
- New D1 migration `0012_organization_offboarding.sql` adds `organization_offboarding`, which lets the same admin finish a deletion after a crash. Its SHA-256 is in `d1-migrations.lock.json`.
- Web UI for export and deletion, with messages in the catalog.

## Scope notes

- Backups are not wiped by deletion. They expire after `Policy.backupRetentionDays` (30) days.
- Export and deletion are both Organization-admin only.

## Verification

- Privacy suite: `OrganizationOffboarding.privacy.test.ts`.
- Unit tests: `DirectoryApi` tests, domain tests (`Offboarding.test.ts`, `Permissions.test.ts`) and web tests (`App.scene.test.ts`, `App.story.test.ts`).
- Ran `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm check:ledger`, `pnpm check:comments`, `pnpm test` (1569 pass), `pnpm test:privacy` (279 pass), and the web build. All passed.
- The pre-commit hook ran `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` and passed.
